authorization: Original research objective and passed >=8 robust-rescue gate; freeze models/losses/seeds/budget before features or fitting.

features.encoder: Frozen 30k pi0.5 PaliGemma prefix transformer after original policy input transforms; mean-pool external camera, wrist camera and valid language/state tokens.
features.pca_fit: fit roots only; standardize then PCA then standardize projected coordinates
features.visual_history: previous original factual t60 root feature only at t120; mask absent history at t60
features.cache_reuse_claim: Offline encoder pass is measured extra work. Live VLA-cache sharing not implemented or claimed in this pilot.

targets.progress_scope: Privileged simulator quantities are training labels only; reversible cues, not time fraction, not a certified grasp or monotone progress.

training.sample_weight: Each fit episode totals one; its roots share that weight. Candidates averaged within root.
training.loss: paired: CE(joint, all three candidates)+0.1*BCE(progress)+0.2*BCE(failure)+0.2*SmoothL1(cost); marginal: BCE(all four outcomes)+0.1*BCE(progress)+0.2*SmoothL1(cost); failure: BCE(failure)+0.1*BCE(progress)+0.2*SmoothL1(cost). No-progress removes progress input and auxiliary term.
training.selection: Final update only; no calibration early stopping, no best-seed selection; all three seeds and arithmetic ensemble reported.

constraints: positive added calls / baseline calls <=0.20, episode-weighted
calibration.objective: Maximize episode-weighted mean signed gain; ties prefer lower positive added cost, fewer interventions, stricter threshold.
calibration.failure_trigger_candidate: Choose fixed candidate on fit-failed roots by mean gain minus 0.05 cost, episode-weighted; never use calibration labels to choose it.
calibration.scope: Decision-level development calibration, not held-out deployment or a safety guarantee. Do not splice t60/t120 branch outcomes into an online episode score.

next_gate.action: Only if the primary paired_progress pilot passes, prepare a separately frozen closed-loop development test and VLA cache-tap identity checks. Otherwise analyze learnability without changing this run or opening confirmation.

reporting: Report module seeds separately from one VLA seed
No inference of deployed improvement from oracle or calibration results
Feature extraction time and module training time charged separately; no new VLA updates
